Subject: Budget band check & procurement path — Atlas Health follow-up

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we promised to follow up on: 

1) Volume & target unit economics
- You indicated an initial integration using our embedding + chat endpoints with an estimated production volume of ~120M tokens/month after ramp.
- Your stated target for budgeting is approximately $35–$45 per 1M tokens (goal: predictable unit cost for forecasting).
- At 120M tokens/month that maps to roughly $4.2k–$5.4k monthly spend.

2) Procurement constraints we discussed
- Procurement mentioned they prefer starting on a credit-card billing path for pilots up to $10k total monthly spend.
- Any commitment or PO above $15k needs a formal PO + SOW and 2–3 week legal review window.
- Atlass procurement told us PO approvals > $50k will need VP-level sign-off and a completed security questionnaire.

3) Proposed short-term paths (we can do any of these)
- Option A: Start on CC billing for pilot (no PO) — runs at consumption pricing, approximate cost ~$45/1M tokens (no upfront).
- Option B: 6‑week pilot + $20k committed credit (applied to usage) with a draft SOW; procurement will issue PO for the credit amount (recommended if you want invoice terms).
- Option C: 6‑month committed band with a volume discount (tiered pricing). We can prepare numbers for 3- & 6‑month commitments.

Next steps from our side:
- Attached: Redwood pricing deck (short), plus a draft SOW template for a pilot.
- Marissa will prepare a formal pricing option sheet that maps the 120M tokens into the price bands you asked about.
- Can you confirm the procurement contact (name and PO approval threshold) and whether legal needs a dedicated NDA + security addendum?

If you’re available, let’s block 30 minutes on Wed to walk procurement through the SOW/PO path and get alignment.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement/finance: 

- Our short-term goal is exactly what you calculated: ~120M tokens/month with a target budget band of $4.5k–$6k. Finance prefers predictability, so a committed pilot is easier for forecasting.
- Procurement: we can start on CC if spend stays under $10k/month, but we don’t want to use CC for sustained production. For anything where you are requesting an invoice/NET-30, procurement requires a PO. PO threshold: our AP team can approve up to $15k without VP sign-off. PO > $50k requires VP sign-off and formal legal review.
- Security: we do want the standard security addendum; SOC 2 in-scope evidence is required before VP sign-off.

Action items on our end:
- I’ll introduce our procurement lead (Laila Chen) in the next email thread and share our PO template.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood is willing to apply a trial credit that would map against the committed pilot so our finance team sees the spend net of the credit?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Product | Atlas Health
elena@atlashealth.ai | (617) 555-2290

Jordan —

Thanks, sending over recommended options to match their constraints. Draft pricing notes (for internal use / to finalize):

- Base consumption price: $50 / 1M tokens (public consumption baseline).
- Pilot discounted band: $40 / 1M tokens for up to 200M tokens/month for a 6‑week pilot; include a $20k credit applied up‑front (covers ~500k tokens at list price but counted as committed credit).
- Mid-commitment: 3‑month band at $38 / 1M tokens for volumes up to 500M aggregated across months (smoother forecasting).
- Enterprise committed band: $35 / 1M tokens for 6+ months with an agreed monthly minimum (to be negotiated).

Notes on procurement fit:
- For Atlas’s PO threshold (AP approves up to $15k), the pilot with $20k credited PO should be structured as a single PO for the credit amount. That keeps AP happy and gives Atlas invoice terms for pilot consumption.
- We should include a clause: vendor will provide SOC 2 evidence within 10 business days of PO acceptance (we have a SOC 2 pack ready).

Suggested short reply to Elena: confirm yes to $20k credit approach and attach the pilot pricing table + SOW. Also propose Wed 4/21 10:00am PT for procurement walkthrough.
